extraction_text: Indra and Narayana agreed with all the gods to incarnate parts of themselves on Earth.

attributes.purpose: To destroy the enemies of the gods and bring happiness to all worlds

extraction_text: Indra instructed all celestial beings and left Narayana's heavenly palace.
Celestial beings descended to Earth, incarnating in lineages of sages or royal families.
The incarnated beings killed numerous Danavas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, Nagas, and other man-eaters.
Janamejaya requested a complete account of the origins of gods, Danavas, Gandharvas, Apsaras, humans, Yakshas, Rakshasas, and all other beings.
Vaishampayana agreed to narrate the creation and destruction of all beings after paying homage to Brahma.
Brahma created six great sages from his mind: Marichi, Atri, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, and Kratu.

attributes.relationship: Father-Sons

extraction_text: Marichi's son Kashyapa became the progenitor of all beings.

attributes.relationship: Father-Son

extraction_text: Daksha had thirteen daughters: Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kala, Anayu, Simhika, Muni, Kadru, Parvati, Arishta, Vinata, and Kapila, with Kadru also being his daughter.

attributes.relationship: Father-Daughters

extraction_text: Aditi gave birth to twelve Adityas: Dhatri, Mitra, Aryaman, Indra, Varuna, Amsha, Bhaga, Vivasvat, Pushan, Savitri, Tvashtri, and Vishnu.

attributes.relationship: Mother-Sons
attributes.note: Vishnu was the last-born and surpassed all others in virtue.

extraction_text: Diti had one son named Hiranyakashipu, who had five famous sons: Prahlada, Simhalada, Anuhrada, Sivi, and Bashkala.

attributes.relationship: Lineage

extraction_text: Prahlada had three sons: Virochana, Kumbha, and Nikumbha.

attributes.relationship: Father-Sons

extraction_text: Virochana had a powerful son named Bali, who had a famous son named Bana, a great Asura.

attributes.relationship: Lineage

extraction_text: Danu had forty famous sons.
King Vipracitti was the firstborn of the Danava lineage and was renowned.
Numerous Danava sons were born, including Sambara, Namuci, Puloman, Asiloman, Kesin, Anihata, Vrishaparvan, Ajaka, and many others.
Ten powerful sons were born in the Danava family, including Ekaksa, Marici, Pralamba, Naraka, Vatapi, Ilvala, Sata, Kapistha, Danayu, and Dirghajihva.
Simhika gave birth to Rahu, who oppresses the moon and sun, along with Ketu, Soma, and Graha.

supernatural_elements: Rahu oppresses the moon and sun

extraction_text: The Kalaka lineage, descendants of Kalaka, were cruel and known as 'Krodhavasa' (Wrathful Ones).
Mrtayu had four sons: Viskala, Pala, Vira, and the great Asura Vrtra.
Kala (Time) gave birth to sons who were like Death, skilled in warfare, including Samhara, Krodha, Krodhahanta, and Krodhasatru.
Usanas (Sukra), the son of Bhrgu, was the preceptor of the Asuras and had four sons who were priests: Tvastr, Atri, and two others.
Vinata gave birth to Garuda, Aruna, Aruni, and Varuni.
Kadru gave birth to Sesha, Ananta, Vasuki, Takshaka, Kurma, and Kulika.
Additional sons were born, including Bhima, Ugrasena, Suparna, Varuna, Gavampati, Dhrtarastra, and others.
大梵天（Brahma）通过心意创造了六位著名的儿子，即六位大仙。
生主斯塔奴（Sthanu）通过最高的意念创造了十一个儿子，他们被称为十一个楼陀罗（Rudras）。

attributes.relationship: 斯塔奴是十一个楼陀罗的父亲

extraction_text: 列出了十一个楼陀罗的名字：摩哩伽毗耶特（Mrgavyadha）、沙尔婆（Sarva）、尼哩提（Nirriti）、阿吉迦波（Ajakapada）、阿希菩迭（Ahirbudhnya）、毕那紧（Pinakin）、陀诃那（Dahana）、大自在天（Ishvara）、迦波林（Kapalin）、斯塔奴（Sthanu）、世尊存有（Bhava）。

attributes.relationship: 都是斯塔奴的儿子，属于楼陀罗族

extraction_text: 大梵天的六个儿子是：摩利支（Marichi）、鸯耆罗（Angiras）、阿多利（Atri）、补罗斯迭（Pulastya）、补罗诃（Pulaha）、迦罗都（Kratu）。

attributes.relationship: 都是大梵天的儿子

extraction_text: 鸯耆罗有三个儿子：毗诃波提（Brihaspati）、优多帖（Utathya）、僧婆尔多（Samvarta）。

attributes.relationship: 鸯耆罗是父亲，毗诃波提、优多帖、僧婆尔多是儿子

extraction_text: 阿多利有许多个儿子，他们都是精通吠陀、大有成就的仙人。

attributes.relationship: 阿多利是父亲

extraction_text: 补罗斯迭的后代包括罗刹（Rakshasas）、猿猴（Vanaras）、紧那罗（Kinnaras）。

attributes.relationship: 补罗斯迭是罗刹、猿猴、紧那罗的祖先

extraction_text: 补罗诃的后代包括麋鹿、狮子、老虎、紧布鲁沙（Kimpurushas）。

attributes.relationship: 补罗诃是麋鹿、狮子、老虎、紧布鲁沙的祖先

extraction_text: The sons of Kaladu are identical to Kaladu, companions of the sun, renowned in the three worlds, and devoutly observe vows.
The venerable sage Daksha was born from the right thumb of Brahma.

attributes.relationship: Daksha is the son of Brahma

extraction_text: Daksha's wife was born from the left thumb of Brahma.

attributes.relationship: Daksha's wife is born from Brahma

extraction_text: Daksha fathered fifty daughters through his wife.

attributes.relationship: Daksha is father to fifty daughters

extraction_text: Daksha gave ten daughters to Dharma, twenty-seven to Chandra (Moon), and thirteen to Kashyapa in marriage.

Dharma's ten wives are named: Kirti (Fame), Lakshmi (Prosperity), Dhriti (Steadfastness), Medha (Intelligence), Pushti (Plenty), Shraddha (Faith), Kriya (Ritual), Buddhi (Wisdom), Lajja (Modesty), and Mati (Thought).

attributes.relationship: Dharma is husband to these ten wives

extraction_text: Chandra's twenty-seven wives are the Nakshatras (lunar mansions), integral to timekeeping and human life.

attributes.relationship: Chandra is husband to the Nakshatras

extraction_text: Daksha's son is Prajapati, whose sons are the eight Vasus.

attributes.relationship: Daksha is father to Prajapati, who is father to the eight Vasus

extraction_text: The eight Vasus are named: Dhara (Sustainer), Dhruva (Pole Star), Soma (Moon), Aha (Day), Anila (Wind), Anala (Fire), Pratyusha (Dawn), Prabhasa (Light).
Lineage details: Dhara and Dhruva are sons of Tumala; Soma is son of Manasvini; Anila is son of Shusha; Aha is son of Rata; Anala is son of Shandili; Pratyusha and Prabhasa are sons of Prabhata.

Further lineage: Dhara's sons are Dravina and Hutahavyavaha; Dhruva's son is Kala (Time); Soma's son is Varchas (Splendor), who with Manohara fathered Shishira, Prana, and Ramana; Aha's sons are Jyoti, Shrama, Shanta, and Muni; Anala's sons include Kumara (Skanda), Shakha, Vishakha, and Naigameya; Anila's sons with Shiva are Purojava and Avijatagati.
Pratyusha (Dawn) had a son named Devala, who was a sage.

attributes.relationships: Pratyusha is the parent of Devala.

extraction_text: Devala had two sons who were magnanimous and exceptionally wise.

attributes.relationships: Devala is the parent of two unnamed sons.

extraction_text: Brihaspati (Vachaspati) had a sister, a beautiful woman who practiced asceticism and mastered yoga, traveling the universe freely.

attributes.relationships: Brihaspati's sister is a sibling of Brihaspati.

extraction_text: Brihaspati's sister married the eighth Vasu, Prabhasa (Light), and gave birth to Vishvakarma.

attributes.relationships: Brihaspati's sister and Prabhasa are spouses; they are parents of Vishvakarma.
attributes.supernatural_elements: Vishvakarma is the divine architect, creator of crafts and celestial chariots.

extraction_text: Dharma was born from Brahma's right breast in human form, bringing happiness to the world.

attributes.relationships: Dharma is a son of Brahma.
attributes.supernatural_elements: Divine birth from Brahma's body part.

extraction_text: Dharma had three sons: Shama (Peace), Kama (Desire), and Harsha (Joy), who support the world.

attributes.relationships: Dharma is the parent of Shama, Kama, and Harsha.

extraction_text: Kama married Rati (Passion), Shama married Prabhavati (Achievement), and Harsha married Nandi (Delight), maintaining the worlds.

attributes.relationships: Kama and Rati are spouses; Shama and Prabhavati are spouses; Harsha and Nandi are spouses.

extraction_text: Kashyapa, son of Marichi, fathered both Devas (gods) and Asuras (demons), and is the origin of the worlds.

attributes.relationships: Kashyapa is a son of Marichi; Kashyapa is the progenitor of Devas and Asuras.

extraction_text: Tvashtri, wife of Savita, gave birth to the Ashvins (divine twin horsemen) in the form of a mare in the sky.

attributes.relationships: Tvashtri and Savita are spouses; they are parents of the Ashvins.
attributes.supernatural_elements: Birth in mare form in the sky.

extraction_text: Aditi had twelve sons, led by Indra, with Vishnu as the last-born, sustaining the worlds.

attributes.relationships: Aditi is the mother of twelve sons, including Indra and Vishnu.

extraction_text: The text lists divine groups: the Thirty-Three Gods, Rudras, Sadhyas, Maruts, Vasus, Bhrigus, and Adityas.

attributes.relationships: Divine groups with distinct lineages and roles.

extraction_text: Vinata's two sons, Garuda and Aruna, and Brihaspati are counted among the Adityas.

attributes.relationships: Vinata is the mother of Garuda and Aruna; they and Brihaspati are part of the Adityas group.

extraction_text: All herbs and cattle from the Ashvins are considered Kushikas (secret deities).

attributes.relationships: Ashvins are associated with herbs and cattle, classified as Kushikas.

extraction_text: Bhrigu was born from Brahma's heart; his son was Kavi, and Kavi's son was Shukra (the planet Venus).

attributes.relationships: Bhrigu is a son of Brahma; Bhrigu is the parent of Kavi; Kavi is the parent of Shukra.
attributes.supernatural_elements: Birth from Brahma's heart; Shukra is a celestial planet.

extraction_text: Shukra, appointed by Brahma, governs the affairs of all beings in the three worlds, including rain, drought, fear, and peace, and is a master yogi and teacher to both Devas and Asuras.

attributes.supernatural_elements: Shukra has cosmic governance powers and is a spiritual master.

extraction_text: After Shukra's appointment, Bhrigu had another flawless son.

attributes.relationships: Bhrigu is the parent of an unnamed son.

extraction_text: 行落（Rishi）出生时因愤怒从母腹掉落下来，具有神光逼人的苦行法力，以正法为灵魂，睿智不凡。
摩奴的女儿阿卢希是行落的妻子。

attributes.relationship: 夫妻

extraction_text: 优留（股生）是破其股而生，苦行法力广大，神光灿烂，尚是孩童就具备种种美德。
利吉迦是股生的儿子，尔后又有子食火。食火有四个高贵的儿子，其中罗摩是最小的一个，具有种种伟大的美德，精通各种兵刃和法宝，是灭绝刹帝利的主脑。
在食火之前，股生有一百个儿子。他们又有数以千计的儿子。这都是婆利古繁衍的后代。
大梵天有两个儿子陀多（维持者）和毗陀多（创造者），他们的法相保留在世界上，与摩奴同在。

family_connections: 陀多和毗陀多是大梵天的儿子

extraction_text: 陀多和毗陀多的妹妹是女神罗奇密（吉祥天女），以红莲为室，光艳莫比。她的心意所生的儿子是几匹行空的天马。

family_connections: 罗奇密是陀多和毗陀多的妹妹

extraction_text: 伐楼拿的妻子阁耶私吒（殊胜）是太白所生的一位女神，她生下儿子波罗和众神喜爱的苏罗仙酒。

family_connections: 阁耶私吒是伐楼拿的妻子
波罗和苏罗仙酒是阁耶私吒的儿子

extraction_text: 从渴求食物而互相吞噬的众生中，生出了阿达磨（非法）。他是一切众生的毁灭者。

attributes.origin: 从互相吞噬的众生中生出

extraction_text: 阿达磨的妻子是尼梨蒂，由他而生的尼梨蒂之子是罗刹。尼梨蒂的三个儿子十分凶恶，总是热衷于犯罪作恶。他们是跋耶（恐怖）、摩诃跋耶（大恐怖）和导致众生丧命的摩哩提逾（死亡）。

family_connections: 尼梨蒂是阿达磨的妻子
跋耶、摩诃跋耶、摩哩提逾是尼梨蒂的儿子

extraction_text: 达姆罗女神生了迦吉（雌乌鸦）、湿耶尼（雌鹰）、跋悉（雌兀鹰）、持国，以及修吉（雌鹦鹉）。她们五个举世闻名。

family_connections: 迦吉、湿耶尼、跋悉、持国、修吉是达姆罗女神的女儿

extraction_text: 迦吉生下了众乌鸦，湿耶尼生下了众鹰隼，跋悉生下了兀鹰和众猛禽。
光彩动人的持国，生育了众天鹅和各种各样的鸭鹅之属，以及对你吉利的鸳鸯。
聪慧的修吉，明法知礼者啊！生育了众鹦鹉。她美丽优雅，仪态万方，具备一切妙相，是位令人崇拜的女郎。
有九个‘迦娄陀婆沙’（愤怒之威）群体的女子是自己产生的。她们是摩哩吉（牝鹿）、摩哩伽门陀（笨兽）、诃利和贤意，有摩登吉（母象）、沙尔都利（母虎）、湿毗达（雪白）、苏罗毗，以及具有一切庄严妙相、享有美誉的苏罗娑（妙味）。

attributes: 苏罗娑具有一切庄严妙相、享有美誉

extraction_text: 各种麋鹿都是摩哩吉的后代，摩哩伽门陀的后代是熊罴、沼泽鹿，还有犛牛。
贤意生下了大象爱罗婆多为儿子。她的儿子爱罗婆多是一头神象，一头伟大的象。

family_connections: 爱罗婆多是贤意的儿子

extraction_text: 诃利的后代是黄毛猴和敏捷的林猴。据说，对你吉利的牛尾猴，也是诃利的儿子。
沙尔都利生下了狮子和老虎，还有各种豹。
摩登吉的后代是众象。
湿毗达生下了一头方位大象，取名湿毗多（雪白），行走十分迅速。
苏罗毗生下了两个女儿，卢醯尼（金牛星）和甘陀毗。
卢醯尼生下了众牛。
甘陀毗生出了众马为子。
苏罗娑生出了群龙，还有众多褐蛇。
阿那腊曾生出七种圆果树。
修吉又是阿那腊的女儿，苏罗娑又是迦德卢的女儿。
湿耶尼是阿噜诺的妻子，生下了两个英勇非凡、力量无穷的儿子，商波底和阇吒优私。
毗娜达有两个儿子，是赫赫有名的迦楼罗（金翅鸟）和阿噜诺（曙光）。
